nodes.name: Every 15 minutes
nodes.notes: A calendar changes less often than an inbox but matters more when it does - a moved meeting you learn about late is worse than a mail you read late.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Non-secret shaping only. The OAuth token is in n8n's credential store - Jytte never sees it, and no agent can reach it.

nodes.name: Fetch today events
nodes.notes: Needs delegated Calendars.Read added to the SAME Entra app registration the mail flow uses. One registration, two scopes - do both at once. Repoint this node at the real credential; the id here is a placeholder.

meta.notes: Calendar fetch for the `calendar` widget. Microsoft Graph via the microsoftOutlook node (event:getAll over today's window). CREDENTIAL RULE: the OAuth token lives only in n8n. Jytte stores no calendar credential and no agent can reach one - the widget is source: n8n and has no Python client. Needs delegated Calendars.Read on the same Entra registration as the mail flow. Activate only after the credential is connected and this node is repointed at it.
